method: Ran the W6 offline verifier with Python stdlib and fake Anthropic SDK. Eleven checks cover full lesson scope, code compilation/readability, zero-call default, bounded opt-in, exclusive archive creation, failed-attempt retention, and a durable write-ahead marker for process interruption. Checked current Anthropic Messages/stop-reason/Python SDK and prompt-injection guidance plus OWASP LLM01:2025. providerCalls=0; externalNetworkCalls=0.
limitations: Historical DeepSeek 0/6, 2/6, and 6/6 results remain unreproducible without per-call traces and the scorer.
Fake SDK tests verify local control flow only; they do not establish current live SDK/provider behavior, model resistance, semantic scoring validity, costs, or production authorization.
Exact quote presence in an allowlisted record does not prove semantic entailment or source truth.
